actions.name: column_chart
actions.title: Generate column chart
actions.description: Generate column chart from data list
actions.help: Takes in a list of data values and labels, and generates a corresponding column chart. A link to the generated column chart will be available in the datatree.

input.name: items
input.label: Chart data
input.hint: Values to pass into the chart

input.name: title
input.label: Chart title
input.hint: Chart title displayed in the generated chart image

input.name: width
input.label: Width
input.hint: Width of the generated chart image, in pixels

input.name: height
input.label: Height
input.hint: Height of the generated chart image, in pixels
